{{Quote|Orbalisks torment their host with constant agony. A Nikto whom I trained as a dark side adept could not handle the pain. Useless.|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
An [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|'''Dark Side Adept''']] was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. This adept was subjected to the effects of [[orbalisk]]s by Palpatine, but could not handle the immense pain caused by the creatures. Recollecting upon the Nikto while making notes in his [[Book of Sith]], Palpatine declared his former student to be useless.
